Each LLG corresponds to a distinct aspect of managing support tickets: assignment, notification, reassignment, and performance tracking. There is no missing essential capability or misleading information.

The system automatically assigns support tickets (llg_001), notifies agents (llg_002), reassigns inactive tickets after 24 hours (llg_003), and updates agent performance statistics based on ticket activity (llg_004). These actions align with the parent goal's description of enabling customer-service agents to manage support tickets with timely responses, automatic reassignment, and performance tracking.

There are no unsupported or misleading LLGs. The scope is correct, and there is no duplication. Each LLG represents a unique aspect of the support ticket management process, contributing to the overall goal of delivering responsive and efficient customer support.
